# Silicon Tundra

> Silicon Tundra is the AI and Automation Navigator for small and medium businesses. We help
> home, commercial & field services companies, real estate professionals, specialty manufacturers,
> lifestyle medicine practices, logistics operators, rental & B2B operations, animal & pet care
> businesses, and agriculture & extraction operators automate workflows and adopt smarter tools —
> so their teams spend more time on what their business does best.

Website: https://www.silicontundrallc.com
Contact: jon@silicontundrallc.com

## Services

- Automation & AI Development — AI receptionists and voice agents, custom AI agents for follow-up,
  reactivation, reviews and admin, and end-to-end automations that replace manual workflows.
  https://www.silicontundrallc.com/services/automation-ai-development
- AI & Automation Consultation — a $5,000 assessment that finds wasted hours, missed revenue, and
  manual workflows, with a money-back guarantee and the fee credited toward any build.
  https://www.silicontundrallc.com/services/consultation
- AI Product Studio — custom web apps (dashboards, client portals, booking tools, lead management,
  MVPs) built from your workflows. You bring the problem; we build the product.
  https://www.silicontundrallc.com/services/product-studio
